subtitle: A simple observability pattern for agent UIs

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A silent UI feels broken while the backend works.

sections.heading: Keep it readable
sections.body: Collapse long tool outputs, but keep them available for debugging.

sections.heading: Why it helps
sections.body: You can see retrieval, tool selection, and returned data before the final answer.

sections.heading: Production lesson
sections.body: Agent UX and agent observability often overlap.
